topography.project_purpose: YieldFi is a yield aggregator that optimizes returns across multiple chains by pooling user deposits into vaults and issuing yield-bearing tokens. It supports cross-chain operations through bridges and manages governance via dedicated manager contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: V1 and V2 families share governance infrastructure through Manager contracts and rely on bridges for cross-chain asset movement. The YieldFi vaults likely interact with yield-bearing tokens from both versions to aggregate user deposits.
